reviewBoundary: Three grade7 fifteen-sentence form sets, three grade8 twelve-choice sets and three grade9 ten-choice sets:111 scoring items in9 complete practices. English prompts and options, five non-given positions preserved in grade7, same-author full-option/grammar/variant review only; no independent calibration.

units.title: Fifteen sentences: beside the sea
units.instruction: Complete all fifteen independent sentences. Ungiven gaps take ONE word; supplied-word gaps take the correct form, without an extra one-word limit.
units.alignmentNote: Complete fifteen-sentence form set. Five unprompted positions1/4/9/12/15 and ten supplied-word positions retained; no claim of distinct concepts for every scoring item.

materials.title: Fifteen sentences: beside the sea
materials.text: The fifteen sentences are independent. Use each sentence’s full context; a supplied word appears in brackets.

questions.prompt: Choose just one: we can draw the boats ____ photograph them.
questions.explanation: Or offers alternatives under the one-choice instruction.

questions.prompt: Leo has a blue bucket. ____ (he) bucket is beside the bag.
questions.explanation: His determines bucket; other forms do not.

questions.prompt: There ____ (be) exactly two boats beside the pier now.
questions.explanation: Plural boats takes are.

questions.prompt: The little flag is ____ the two larger flags, with one on each side.
questions.explanation: Between expresses the specified two-sided position.

questions.prompt: Three ____ (child) are drawing the harbour.
questions.explanation: Three requires irregular plural children.

questions.prompt: The sunhat belongs to Nina. It is ____ (Nina) sunhat.
questions.explanation: The name requires a possessive ending.

questions.prompt: There are five wooden ____ (bench) along the path.
questions.explanation: Five requires plural benches.

questions.prompt: Please ____ (stay) with the group beside the harbour.
questions.explanation: A positive imperative uses base stay.

questions.prompt: —____ are the drawing pencils? —In the red bag.
questions.explanation: A place answer requires Where.

questions.prompt: Our visitor teaches ____ (France) at a school.
questions.explanation: French names the language; France names the country.

questions.prompt: The boat moved ____ (slow) through the harbour.
questions.explanation: Slowly and standard flat slow modify moved; slowness is a noun.

questions.prompt: We saw ____ enormous ship beyond the small boats.
questions.explanation: Enormous begins with a vowel sound.

questions.prompt: The guide gave ____ (we) a map of the harbour.
questions.explanation: Gave takes object us.

questions.prompt: I would like ____ (draw) the lighthouse next.
questions.explanation: Would like takes a to-infinitive, including the possible progressive form.

questions.prompt: We stayed beside the wall ____ the guide asked us to wait there.
questions.explanation: Reason conjunctions introduce the finite clause; during cannot.

units.title: Fifteen sentences: in the assembly hall
units.instruction: Complete all fifteen independent sentences. Ungiven gaps take ONE word; supplied-word gaps take the correct form, without an extra one-word limit.
units.alignmentNote: Complete fifteen-sentence form set. Five unprompted positions1/4/9/12/15 and ten supplied-word positions retained; no claim of distinct concepts for every scoring item.

materials.title: Fifteen sentences: in the assembly hall
materials.text: The fifteen sentences are independent. Use each sentence’s full context; a supplied word appears in brackets.

questions.prompt: Use one colour: you may choose purple ____ orange for the border.
questions.explanation: Or presents the permitted alternatives.

questions.prompt: The pupils brought a banner. ____ (they) banner has a white border.
questions.explanation: Their determines banner.

questions.prompt: There ____ (be) one empty seat beside the aisle now.
questions.explanation: One empty seat requires is.

questions.prompt: The small bag is ____ the chair; the seat is directly above it.
questions.explanation: The bag is lower than the seat, under/beneath/below it.

questions.prompt: The display has four paper ____ (butterfly).
questions.explanation: Four requires butterflies with y changed to ies.

questions.prompt: The red folder belongs to Omar. It is ____ (Omar) folder.
questions.explanation: The owner name needs a possessive ending.

questions.prompt: There are three ____ (watch) in the lost-property tray.
questions.explanation: Three requires plural watches.

questions.prompt: Do not ____ (block) the doorway with your bag.
questions.explanation: Do not takes the base verb.

questions.prompt: —____ does the talk start? —At nine thirty.
questions.explanation: A start time answers When.

questions.prompt: The speaker reads ____ (China) stories in their original language.
questions.explanation: Chinese modifies stories and names the language; China is a country.

questions.prompt: The teacher explained the plan ____ (clear).
questions.explanation: Clearly modifies explained.

questions.prompt: This is ____ useful diagram of the seating plan.
questions.explanation: Useful starts with consonant /j/.

questions.prompt: The teacher asked ____ (I) to collect the spare programmes.
questions.explanation: Asked takes object me.

questions.prompt: We hope ____ (finish) setting out the chairs before nine.
questions.explanation: Hope takes to-infinitive here.

questions.prompt: Keep the aisle clear ____ people can reach their seats.
questions.explanation: So introduces the intended result; during cannot join the clauses.

units.title: Fifteen sentences: at the grocery shop
units.instruction: Complete all fifteen independent sentences. Ungiven gaps take ONE word; supplied-word gaps take the correct form, without an extra one-word limit.
units.alignmentNote: Complete fifteen-sentence form set. Five unprompted positions1/4/9/12/15 and ten supplied-word positions retained; no claim of distinct concepts for every scoring item.

materials.title: Fifteen sentences: at the grocery shop
materials.text: The fifteen sentences are independent. Use each sentence’s full context; a supplied word appears in brackets.

questions.prompt: Choose one bag: the green one ____ the blue one.
questions.explanation: Or links the two choices.

questions.prompt: Maya has a shopping list. ____ (she) list is on the counter.
questions.explanation: Her determines list.

questions.prompt: There ____ (be) exactly six apples in the basket now.
questions.explanation: Six apples requires plural are.

questions.prompt: The shop opens ____ eight o’clock every morning.
questions.explanation: Clock time takes at.

questions.prompt: We bought two ____ (loaf) of bread.
questions.explanation: Two requires irregular plural loaves.

questions.prompt: The reusable bag belongs to Dad. It is ____ (Dad) bag.
questions.explanation: Possessive Dad’s determines bag.

questions.prompt: The shelf holds several empty ____ (box).
questions.explanation: Several requires plural boxes.

questions.prompt: Please ____ (put) the heavy bag on the floor.
questions.explanation: An imperative uses base put.

questions.prompt: —____ bag is this? —It belongs to my aunt.
questions.explanation: Whose asks ownership before the noun.

questions.prompt: The label says these are ____ (Italy) tomatoes.
questions.explanation: Italian is the nationality adjective modifying tomatoes.

questions.prompt: Please pack the soft fruit ____ (gentle).
questions.explanation: Gently modifies pack.

questions.prompt: We need ____ onion for the soup.
questions.explanation: Onion starts with a vowel sound.

questions.prompt: The assistant gave ____ (they) the receipt.
questions.explanation: Gave takes object them.

questions.prompt: I would like ____ (carry) the smaller bag.
questions.explanation: Would like takes to-infinitive, including possible progressive.

questions.prompt: We waited indoors ____ the heavy rain stopped.
questions.explanation: Until/till marks the endpoint; before also locates the earlier waiting. During cannot introduce the clause.

units.title: Twelve choices: at the planetarium
units.instruction: Choose the best option for every complete sentence or short conversation.
units.alignmentNote: Complete twelve-item grade8 or ten-item grade9 four-option language-use set. Standalone sentences are kept in junior levels only; no senior Gaokao claim.

materials.title: Twelve choices: at the planetarium
materials.text: Read each sentence or short conversation in full. Choose one complete option per item.

questions.prompt: Eva brought a notebook. ____ notebook has a silver cover.
questions.explanation: Her determines notebook; other pronoun forms do not.

questions.prompt: Our visit is ____ March.
questions.explanation: A month takes in.

questions.prompt: The first show was full, ____ we booked the next one.
questions.explanation: So marks the resulting booking; the other links do not express that causal direction.

questions.prompt: This model is much ____ than the one in our classroom.
questions.explanation: Much plus than takes comparative larger.

questions.prompt:
—Must we bring our own pencils?
—No, you ____. Pencils are provided.
questions.explanation: Needn’t removes obligation; the others prohibit or express different meanings.

questions.prompt:
—____ did you travel to the planetarium?
—By bus.
questions.explanation: By bus answers method How.

questions.prompt: The centre usually ____ at ten in the morning.
questions.explanation: A habitual present with singular centre takes opens.

questions.prompt: Yesterday, the guide ____ us a model of the Moon.
questions.explanation: Yesterday requires the past event showed.

questions.prompt: At eleven yesterday, we ____ a film when the guide returned.
questions.explanation: The interrupted ongoing past action takes were watching.

questions.prompt: If the weather is clear tomorrow, we ____ through the telescope with the guide.
questions.explanation: Future real condition takes will look in the result clause.

questions.prompt: Of all four groups, ours listened ____.
questions.explanation: Four-group ranking requires a superlative adverb.

questions.prompt: The guide invited us ____ questions after the show.
questions.explanation: Invite someone to ask takes to-infinitive.

units.title: Twelve choices: the sewing room
units.instruction: Choose the best option for every complete sentence or short conversation.
units.alignmentNote: Complete twelve-item grade8 or ten-item grade9 four-option language-use set. Standalone sentences are kept in junior levels only; no senior Gaokao claim.

materials.title: Twelve choices: the sewing room
materials.text: Read each sentence or short conversation in full. Choose one complete option per item.

questions.prompt: Please give the cloth to Sam. It belongs to ____.
questions.explanation: Belong to takes object him for the owner.

questions.prompt: The class meets ____ Wednesday afternoons.
questions.explanation: A named day with afternoon takes on.

questions.prompt: We used a different cloth ____ the first piece was too small.
questions.explanation: Because introduces the reason for changing cloth.

questions.prompt: This thread is ____ than the old one.
questions.explanation: Than selects comparative stronger.

questions.prompt:
—____ I finish the whole bag today?
—No, you needn’t. We have another lesson.
questions.explanation: Needn’t directly answers the obligation question Must.

questions.prompt:
—____ do we keep the spare buttons?
—In that labelled box.
questions.explanation: A storage location answers Where.

questions.prompt: Our teacher always ____ the equipment before class.
questions.explanation: The habitual singular subject takes checks.

questions.prompt: Last Tuesday, I ____ a small pocket for my bag.
questions.explanation: Last Tuesday requires past made.

questions.prompt: At three yesterday, I ____ a line when the teacher came over.
questions.explanation: Past ongoing drawing is interrupted by arrival.

questions.prompt: If we finish early tomorrow, we ____ the tables before leaving.
questions.explanation: A future real condition takes will clear.

questions.prompt: Of the five learners, Rosa worked ____.
questions.explanation: Five-person comparison takes superlative adverb.

questions.prompt: The teacher asked us ____ before using the equipment.
questions.explanation: Ask someone to wait takes to-infinitive.

units.title: Twelve choices: recording a story
units.instruction: Choose the best option for every complete sentence or short conversation.
units.alignmentNote: Complete twelve-item grade8 or ten-item grade9 four-option language-use set. Standalone sentences are kept in junior levels only; no senior Gaokao claim.

materials.title: Twelve choices: recording a story
materials.text: Read each sentence or short conversation in full. Choose one complete option per item.

questions.prompt: We have a microphone. ____ microphone is on the desk.
questions.explanation: Our determines microphone.

questions.prompt: The recording session begins ____ half past two.
questions.explanation: Clock time takes at.

questions.prompt: The corridor was noisy, ____ we closed the door before recording.
questions.explanation: So links the noise to its practical result.

questions.prompt: This version is much ____ than the first recording.
questions.explanation: Much and than select clearer.

questions.prompt:
—Must I record the whole story again?
—No, you ____. Only the last paragraph needs replacing.
questions.explanation: Needn’t removes the obligation to redo everything.

questions.prompt:
—____ did you stop the recording?
—Because someone knocked at the door.
questions.explanation: Because gives a reason, answering Why.

questions.prompt: My partner usually ____ the opening paragraph.
questions.explanation: A present routine with singular partner takes reads.

questions.prompt: Yesterday, we ____ the final file to our teacher.
questions.explanation: Yesterday requires past sent.

questions.prompt: At four yesterday, we ____ the ending when the bell rang.
questions.explanation: Ongoing past checking is interrupted by the bell.

questions.prompt: If the teacher approves the file tomorrow, we ____ it to the class page.
questions.explanation: Future real condition takes will add.

questions.prompt: Of the three readers, Mia spoke ____.
questions.explanation: Three-person ranking takes superlative adverb.

questions.prompt: We hope ____ another story next month.
questions.explanation: Hope to record takes infinitive.

units.title: Ten choices: visiting the aquarium
units.instruction: Choose the best option for every complete sentence or short conversation.
units.alignmentNote: Complete twelve-item grade8 or ten-item grade9 four-option language-use set. Standalone sentences are kept in junior levels only; no senior Gaokao claim.

materials.title: Ten choices: visiting the aquarium
materials.text: Read each sentence or short conversation in full. Choose one complete option per item.

questions.prompt: We saw ____ unusual fish in ____ large tank.
questions.explanation: Unusual takes an; large takes a by initial sounds.

questions.prompt: If the tickets ____ today, our teacher will collect them tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Tickets receive printing, so present passive in the real condition.

questions.prompt: The guide gave clear ____ about which areas were closed.
questions.explanation: Information communicates the closure details; the other nouns do not.

questions.prompt: Please speak ____ enough for the group to hear your question.
questions.explanation: Clearly enough means intelligibly.

questions.prompt: That dark shape ____ be a ray, but I am not sure.
questions.explanation: May expresses uncertainty rather than certainty or impossibility.

questions.prompt: The school booked exactly ____ tickets:199 plus one.
questions.explanation: Exact200 is two hundred without plural s or of.

questions.prompt: ____ the first room was crowded, we found a quiet place in the next one.
questions.explanation: Although contrasts the two experiences.

questions.prompt: Don’t ____ the glass. If you ____ it, the staff will ask you to stop.
questions.explanation: The imperative and real-condition present both use tap.

questions.prompt: The volunteer ____ led our group answered the final question.
questions.explanation: Human subject relative who fits; the other forms do not.

questions.prompt:
—Could you tell me ____?
—At the main entrance.
questions.explanation: A place answer requires embedded where with statement order.

units.title: Ten choices: a class newspaper
units.instruction: Choose the best option for every complete sentence or short conversation.
units.alignmentNote: Complete twelve-item grade8 or ten-item grade9 four-option language-use set. Standalone sentences are kept in junior levels only; no senior Gaokao claim.

materials.title: Ten choices: a class newspaper
materials.text: Read each sentence or short conversation in full. Choose one complete option per item.

questions.prompt: We interviewed ____ artist who works at ____ university.
questions.explanation: Artist starts with a vowel sound; university begins with /j/.

questions.prompt: If the article ____ by this evening, it will appear in Friday’s issue.
questions.explanation: The article receives approval, present passive in the condition.

questions.prompt: The editor made several useful ____ for improving the headline.
questions.explanation: Suggestions are proposed improvements to the headline.

questions.prompt: Write the source details ____ so another person can check them.
questions.explanation: Clearly supplies readable, understandable details.

questions.prompt: This photograph ____ belong to the school archive, but we need to check the record.
questions.explanation: May fits tentative ownership requiring confirmation.

questions.prompt: We printed exactly ____ copies, not299.
questions.explanation: Exact300 uses three hundred.

questions.prompt: ____ the interview was short, it gave us enough material for the article.
questions.explanation: Even though marks concession.

questions.prompt: Don’t ____ the draft. If you ____ it, we will lose the unrecorded changes.
questions.explanation: Negative imperative and real condition use base/present delete.

questions.prompt: An editor is someone ____ checks and prepares writing for publication.
questions.explanation: Someone takes human subject relative who among the options.

questions.prompt:
—Do you know ____?
—At four o’clock.
options: what time does the editor arrive
questions.explanation: A time answer requires embedded what-time with statement order.

units.title: Ten choices: a kite exhibition
units.instruction: Choose the best option for every complete sentence or short conversation.
units.alignmentNote: Complete twelve-item grade8 or ten-item grade9 four-option language-use set. Standalone sentences are kept in junior levels only; no senior Gaokao claim.

materials.title: Ten choices: a kite exhibition
materials.text: Read each sentence or short conversation in full. Choose one complete option per item.

questions.prompt: It was ____ enjoyable visit to ____ European kite exhibition.
questions.explanation: Enjoyable begins with vowel sound; European starts with consonant /j/.

questions.prompt: If the hall ____ before noon, we will display our kites there.
questions.explanation: Hall receives opening; only present passive fits the condition.

questions.prompt: The leaflet gives clear ____ to the hall, including a map of the streets.
questions.explanation: Directions supply route information.

questions.prompt: The presenter explained the folds ____ enough for beginners to follow.
questions.explanation: Clearly enough expresses intelligibility.

questions.prompt: The blue kite ____ be Lena’s, but I have not seen her name on it.
questions.explanation: May expresses possible ownership without certainty.

questions.prompt: There are exactly ____ paper kites, not399.
questions.explanation: Exact400 is four hundred.

questions.prompt: ____ the wind was too strong for flying outside, the indoor display still went ahead.
questions.explanation: Although contrasts unsuitable flying weather with an ongoing indoor display.

questions.prompt: Don’t ____ the string across the doorway. If you ____ it there, someone may trip.
questions.explanation: Imperative leave and real-condition present leave are required.

questions.prompt: The artist ____ made the largest kite gave a short talk.
questions.explanation: Who is the human subject relative.

questions.prompt:
—Could you tell me ____?
—At the west door.
questions.explanation: The place answer requires embedded where with statement order.
